page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 dedicated vCPUs, 2 physical cores, and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1303.98, and the multi-core score is 1735.19, both categorized as weak to poor. Memory bandwidth tests show 95.52 GB/sec for cached small blocks and drop to 12.93 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In application-specific tests, the instance achieves 1.69 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 1.93 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6.large offers a dedicated CPU allocation at a lower entry point, but its limited memory capacity of 2.0 GB per core presents a tradeoff for memory-intensive applications. It is best suited for lightweight compute tasks, basic web serving, single-threaded software compilation, and low-throughput database operations where dedicated CPU resources are required but memory demands are minimal.
